mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 3.64% is at a historically accommodative level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of trading days when FEDFUNDS is within 0.05% of 3.64%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals economic distress and increased equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of trading days when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.7%) and high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 327.5) indicates stagflation risk, increasing equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of FEDFUNDS < 3.7% and CPIAUCSL > 327.5 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST > 1480) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1 > 24000) indicate sustained economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the combination of HOUST > 1480 and GDPC1 > 24000 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 327.5) signals elevated inflation risk, increasing equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of trading days when CPIAUCSL > 327.5.

mechanism_narrative: The current employment level of 158466 thousand is high and signals a strong labor market, reducing equity risk and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of trading days when PAYEMS is within 0.5% of 158466.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous high employment level (PAYEMS > 158000) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) indicates a labor market shock, increasing equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of PAYEMS > 158000 and UNRATE > 4.0% produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.
